data.name: Buraidah
data.long_meaning: The name Buraidah is derived from the Arabic word 'Buraida', which means 'gardens of delight'. In Islamic tradition, this name is associated with Buraidah bint Al-Ash'ath, a noblewoman from the time of Prophet Muhammad (pbuh). She was known for her generosity and hospitality to the early Muslim community.
